newsitem.title: NORWAY: Gas leak shuts Saga's Vigdis oilfield.
newsitem.headline: Gas leak shuts Saga's Vigdis oilfield.

text.p: Saga Petroleum ASA said on Monday it expected to restart the North Sea Vigdis oilfield at the beginning of June after an unscheduled shutdown due to a gas leak.

Production at the development was shut in at 1044 GMT on Friday following a gas alarm at the nearby Snorre development. Output also was halted at Snorre after the alert but was resumed a couple of hours later, Saga spokesman Bjoern Schibevaag told Reuters.
"We found a leak in the gas compressor at Vigdis and we need new seals. We will be down until the beginning of June," he said.
Vigdis, which came on stream in January five months ahead of schedule, suffered an unscheduled shutdown on April 15 due to other problems with the gas compressor. The field was restarted on May 16.
Schibevaag said production was around 50,000 barrels per day before the latest incident.
